name: sectrex-website
description: Tailwind build for the Sectrex Consulting site.

scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run build:css
scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/fonts static/js && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2 static/fonts/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2 static/fonts/ && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/js/alpine.min.js
